description: This file defines a React component 'PharmacistView' which provides a user interface for verifying digital signatures related to medical prescriptions. It includes functions to parse JSON input, verify signatures both from JSON data and separate fields, and displays verification results.

methods.name: parseFromJson
methods.description: Parses JSON input to extract message, signature, and doctor's public key, returning a Parsed object with verification status.

methods.name: onVerifyFromJson
methods.description: Handles verification of the signature based on JSON input; updates result state accordingly.

methods.name: onVerifyManual
methods.description: Verifies the signature using separately entered message, signature, and public key fields.
